instruction: Modify the Slide Master to set 'Times New Roman' as the universal font family for all text throughout the presentation

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing all text fonts to 'Times New Roman' via Slide Master view. The custom getter extracts all unique fonts used across all slides, and the metric checks that only 'Times New Roman' is present. This is verified by iterating through all slides, shapes, paragraphs, and runs to collect font names.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts fonts from both Slide Master/layouts and individual slides, separating them into master_fonts and slide_fonts
Metric correctly requires master_fonts to contain Times New Roman, verifying Slide Master was modified
Metric allows slide_fonts to be empty (inheritance) or contain only Times New Roman, handling both explicit and inherited fonts
Final check ensures only Times New Roman is present across all fonts (master + slides)
Minor edge case: If LibreOffice stores master font at theme level without explicit shape text, getter might not capture it, but this is unlikely in typical usage
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding fallback to check presentation.slide_master theme properties if master_fonts is empty
Could add explicit check for default font theme settings in addition to shape-level fonts
Edge case handling: Verify behavior when master font is set via theme vs. explicit shape formatting
